nodes.summary: For natural numbers $d$ and $j$, $b^d_j$ is the complex polynomial $b^d_j = \prod_{i=0}^{d-1} (X + d - j - i)$.
nodes.title: The basis polynomials $b^d_j$

nodes.summary: For an integer $n$ and a natural number $d$, the binomial polynomial $\binom{X+n}{d}$ is the real polynomial $\frac{1}{d!} \prod_{i=0}^{d-1} (X + n - i)$.
nodes.title: Binomial polynomial

nodes.summary: For every positive integer $d$, the set $\Omega_d$ of canonical-line roots of degree-$d$ CL-polynomials satisfying $(\diamondsuit)$ is a nonempty connected subset of $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: The set of attainable canonical-line roots is connected

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, $\Omega_d$ is the set of complex numbers $z$ on the canonical line such that $z$ is a root of some CL-polynomial of degree $d$ satisfying $(\diamondsuit)$.
nodes.title: The set $\Omega_d$ of attainable canonical-line roots

nodes.summary: The canonical line $\mathrm{CL}$ is the vertical line of complex numbers with real part $-1/2$, that is, $\mathrm{CL} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} z = -1/2\}$.
nodes.title: Canonical line

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a complex polynomial of degree $d$ that is a CL-polynomial with real scale $a$ and list of real parameters $c_1, \dots, c_m$, and suppose that $f$ is SNN. Then for each parameter $c_k$ there is a real number $\beta$ such that $-\tfrac12 + \beta i$ is a root of the symmetric basis polynomial $p^d_0$ and $c_k \le \tfrac14 + \beta^2$.
nodes.title: Parameter bound for SNN CL-polynomials

nodes.summary: For a finite list $c_1, \dots, c_m$ of real numbers, this is the monic complex polynomial $\prod_{k=1}^{m} (X^2 + X + c_k)$; the empty list gives the constant polynomial $1$.
nodes.title: Product of quadratic canonical-line factors

nodes.summary: If $f$ is a CL-polynomial of degree $d$, then for every $z$ on the canonical line there is a real number $r$ with $f(z) = r\, i^d$; that is, $f$ maps the canonical line into $\mathbb{R}\, i^d$.
nodes.title: Values of CL-polynomials on the canonical line

nodes.summary: A complex polynomial $f$ CL-interlaces a complex polynomial $g$ when $f$ and $g$ are nonzero, $\deg g = \deg f + 1$, all roots of $f$ and of $g$ lie on the canonical line, and, writing $d = \deg f$ and listing the roots with multiplicity as $a_1, \dots, a_d$ for $f$ and $b_1, \dots, b_{d+1}$ for $g$, each list sorted by increasing imaginary part, they alternate:…
nodes.title: Interlacing on the canonical line

nodes.summary: Let $d \le 9$, let $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ be the convex hull of a finite set of integer points, and suppose that $P$ is reflexive. Let $\Delta^d_{sr}$ be the standard reflexive simplex, with vertices $e_1, \dots, e_d$ and $-(e_1 + \cdots + e_d)$. Let $E$ and $E'$ be complex polynomials such that, for every natural number $k$, $E(k)$ is the number of integer points of $kP$ and $E'(k)$ is the number of integer…
nodes.title: Ehrhart CL-spans of reflexive polytopes in dimension at most 9

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a complex polynomial of degree $d$ that is both a CL-polynomial and an SNN polynomial. Then the CL-span of $f$ is contained in the CL-span of the symmetric basis polynomial $p^d_0$.
nodes.title: CL-span bound for SNN CL-polynomials

nodes.summary: The zero polynomial has empty CL-span (its root multiset is empty).
nodes.title: CL-span of the zero polynomial

nodes.summary: The CL-span of a complex polynomial $f$ is the convex hull, in $\mathbb{C}$ viewed as a real vector space, of the set of roots of $f$ lying on the canonical line, the line of complex numbers with real part $-1/2$. Here the zero polynomial is regarded as having no roots, so its CL-span is empty.
nodes.title: CL-span

nodes.summary: Let $(f_n)$ and $(g_n)$ be sequences of real polynomials with only real roots, and let $f$ and $g$ be nonzero real polynomials such that, for every $k$, the coefficient of $X^k$ in $f_n$ tends to that in $f$ and the coefficient of $X^k$ in $g_n$ tends to that in $g$ as $n \to \infty$. Suppose that for all sufficiently large $n$ the degree of $f_n$ equals the degree of $f$ and the degree of $g_n$ equals the degree…
nodes.title: Coefficientwise limits preserve real interlacing

nodes.title: Complex binomial polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $V \subseteq \mathbb{Z}^d$ be a finite set and let $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ be the lattice polytope spanned by $V$, its convex hull. A complex polynomial $E$ counts the lattice points of $P$ when, for every natural number $k$, $E(k)$ equals the ordinary Ehrhart count $|kP \cap \mathbb{Z}^d|$, the number of points of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ of the form $kx$ with $x$ a rational point of $P$.
nodes.title: Polynomial counting the lattice points of dilates

nodes.summary: Let $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ be a full-dimensional lattice polytope, the convex hull of a finite set of points of $\mathbb{Z}^d$, and let $E$ be a complex polynomial with $E(k) = |kP \cap \mathbb{Z}^d|$ for every natural number $k$. Then every complex root $\alpha$ of $E$ satisfies $|\alpha| \le 1 + (d+1)!$, and every real root $\alpha$ of $E$ satisfies $-d \le \alpha < \lfloor d/2 \rfloor$.
nodes.title: Classical bounds on Ehrhart roots

nodes.summary: Let $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ be a full-dimensional lattice polytope, the convex hull of a finite set of points of $\mathbb{Z}^d$, and let $E$ be a complex polynomial with $E(k) = |kP \cap \mathbb{Z}^d|$ for every natural number $k$. Then every root $\alpha$ of $E$ lies in the closed disc centered at $-1/2$ with radius $d(d - 1/2)$, that is, $|\alpha + 1/2| \le d(d - 1/2)$.
nodes.title: Braun's disc for Ehrhart roots

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a nonzero complex polynomial of degree $d$ with $h^*$-coefficients $h^*_0(f), \dots, h^*_d(f)$. Then $f(X-1) = (-1)^d f(-X)$ as polynomials if and only if $h^*_i(f) = h^*_{d-i}(f)$ for every $i \le d$.
nodes.title: Functional equation versus palindromic h-star coefficients

nodes.title: The h-star coefficients of a polynomial

nodes.summary: For a complex polynomial $f$ of degree $d$ and a natural number $i$, let $h^*_i(f)$ be the coefficient of $t^i$ in $(1 - t)^{d+1} \sum_{k \ge 0} f(k)\, t^k$. Then $f$ has property (♢) when $f \ne 0$ and its $h^*$-coefficients $h^*_0(f), \dots, h^*_d(f)$ are real, nonnegative and palindromic, that is, $h^*_i(f) = h^*_{d-i}(f)$ for $0 \le i \le d$.
nodes.title: Property (♢)

nodes.summary: A real polynomial $f$ has only real roots when $f \ne 0$ and the number of real roots of $f$, counted with multiplicity, equals the degree of $f$.
nodes.title: Real-rooted polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ be the lattice polytope spanned by a finite set of points of $\mathbb{Z}^d$, and suppose that $P$ is full-dimensional. Let $E$ be a complex polynomial with $E(k) = |kP \cap \mathbb{Z}^d|$ for every natural number $k$, and write $h^*_i$ for the $h^*$-coefficients of $E$. If $h^*_d \ne 0$, then $\operatorname{Re} h^*_1 \le \operatorname{Re} h^*_k$ for every $k$ with $1 \le k < d$.
nodes.title: Hibi's lower bound

nodes.summary: A complex polynomial $f$ of degree $d$ is a CL-polynomial when there are a real number $a \ne 0$ and real numbers $c_1, \dots, c_m \ge 1/4$ with $m = \lfloor d/2 \rfloor$ such that $f = a \prod_{i=1}^{m} (X^2 + X + c_i)$ if $d$ is even and $f = a (2X + 1) \prod_{i=1}^{m} (X^2 + X + c_i)$ if $d$ is odd.
nodes.title: CL-polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a complex polynomial of degree $d$, let $a$ be a real number, and let $c_1, \dots, c_m$ be a list of real numbers. Then $f$ is a CL-polynomial with scale $a$ and parameters $c_1, \dots, c_m$ when $a \ne 0$, every $c_i \ge 1/4$, $m = \lfloor d/2 \rfloor$, and $f = a \prod_{i=1}^{m} (X^2 + X + c_i)$ if $d$ is even and $f = a (2X + 1) \prod_{i=1}^{m} (X^2 + X + c_i)$ if $d$ is odd.
nodes.title: CL-polynomials with given parameters

nodes.summary: A subset $P$ of $\mathbb{R}^d$ is full-dimensional when it is nonempty and the direction of its affine span is all of $\mathbb{R}^d$ (equivalently, the affine span of $P$ is $\mathbb{R}^d$).
nodes.title: Full-dimensional sets

nodes.summary: For a complex polynomial $f$ of degree $d$ and a natural number $i$, let $h^*_i(f)$ be the coefficient of $t^i$ in $(1 - t)^{d+1} \sum_{k \ge 0} f(k)\, t^k$. Then $f$ is SNN when $f \ne 0$ and its $h^*$-coefficients $h^*_0(f), \dots, h^*_d(f)$ are real and nonnegative.
nodes.title: SNN polynomials

nodes.summary: A lattice point $x = (x_1, \dots, x_d) \in \mathbb{Z}^d$ is regarded as the point of $\mathbb{R}^d$ with the same coordinates $x_1, \dots, x_d$.
nodes.title: Lattice points as real points

nodes.summary: The lattice polytope spanned by a finite set $V \subseteq \mathbb{Z}^d$ is the convex hull in $\mathbb{R}^d$ of the points of $V$.
nodes.title: Lattice polytopes

nodes.summary: Let $f, f_1, g, g_1$ be real polynomials with positive leading coefficients, each having only real roots, such that $f$ and $g$ have no common real root, $f_1$ interlaces $f$, and $g_1$ interlaces $g$. Then $f_1 g_1$ interlaces $f g_1 + f_1 g$, the polynomial $f g_1 + f_1 g$ interlaces $f g$, the roots of $f g_1 + f_1 g$ alternate with those of $f g_1$ and with those of $f_1 g$, and $f g_1 + f_1 g$ has only real…
nodes.title: Fisk's Leibniz rule for interlacing

nodes.summary: Let $r$ be a binary relation on a type $\alpha$ and let $n \ge 0$. A list $(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ alternates with a list $(b_1, \dots, b_n)$ with respect to $r$ when $a_1 \mathrel{r} b_1 \mathrel{r} a_2 \mathrel{r} \cdots \mathrel{r} a_n \mathrel{r} b_n$, that is, $a_k \mathrel{r} b_k$ for $1 \le k \le n$ and $b_k \mathrel{r} a_{k+1}$ for $1 \le k < n$. Two empty lists alternate, and lists of different lengths never…
nodes.title: Alternating lists of equal length

nodes.summary: Let $r$ be a binary relation on a type $\alpha$ and let $d \ge 0$. A list $(a_1, \dots, a_d)$ interlaces a list $(b_1, \dots, b_{d+1})$ with respect to $r$ when $b_1 \mathrel{r} a_1 \mathrel{r} b_2 \mathrel{r} \cdots \mathrel{r} a_d \mathrel{r} b_{d+1}$, that is, $b_k \mathrel{r} a_k$ and $a_k \mathrel{r} b_{k+1}$ for $1 \le k \le d$. Two lists interlace only when the second has exactly one more entry than the…
nodes.title: Interlacing lists

nodes.summary: For $d \ge 0$ let $M_d = \binom{X+d}{d} + \binom{X}{d}$ be the model polynomial. Let $(\beta_d)_{d \ge 0}$ be a sequence of complex numbers such that for every $d \ge 1$, $\beta_d$ is a root of $M_d$ and $|\gamma| \le |\beta_d|$ for every root $\gamma$ of $M_d$. Then $|\beta_d + \tfrac12| - d^2/\pi = O(1)$ as $d \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Asymptotics of the largest root of the model polynomial

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, the model polynomial is the complex polynomial $M_d = \binom{X+d}{d} + \binom{X}{d}$, where for an integer $n$ the binomial polynomial $\binom{X+n}{d}$ is $\frac{1}{d!}\prod_{i=0}^{d-1} (X + n - i)$.
nodes.title: Model polynomial

nodes.summary: For every natural number $d$, let $e_1, \dots, e_d$ be the standard basis vectors of $\mathbb{Z}^d$. Then the point $-(e_1 + \dots + e_d) = (-1, \dots, -1)$ belongs to the vertex set $\{e_1, \dots, e_d, -(e_1 + \dots + e_d)\}$ of the standard reflexive simplex $\Delta^d_{sr}$.
nodes.title: The all-minus-one vector is a vertex of the standard reflexive simplex

Then: (a) the real part of $p^d_j(it - \tfrac12) / i^d$ tends to $+\infty$ as the real number $t$ tends to $+\infty$; (b) if $2j \ne d$, then for every real $t$ we have $p^d_j(it - \tfrac12) = 0$ if and only if there is a real number $r$ with…

nodes.title: The basis polynomial $p^1_0$

nodes.summary: The symmetric basis polynomial $p^2_0$ equals the complex polynomial $2(X^2 + X + 1)$.
nodes.title: The basis polynomial $p^2_0$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $d \ge 1$ and every real number $w > 0$, the symmetric basis polynomial $p^d_0$ CL-interlaces the polynomial $p^{d+1}_0 + w \, (2X + 1) \, p^d_0$.

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $d$ and $j$, let $b^d_j$ be the complex polynomial $\prod_{i=0}^{d-1} (X + d - j - i)$. The polynomial $p^d_j$ is $b^d_j$ if $2j = d$, and $b^d_j + b^d_{d-j}$ otherwise, where $d - j$ is truncated at $0$ (so $p^d_j = b^d_j + b^d_0$ when $j > d$).

nodes.summary: Let $f$ and $g$ be real polynomials. Their roots alternate when $f$ and $g$ are nonzero of the same degree $n$, the real roots of $f$, listed with multiplicity, are exactly $a_1 \le \dots \le a_n$, those of $g$ are exactly $b_1 \le \dots \le b_n$ (so all roots of $f$ and $g$ are real), and either $a_1 \le b_1 \le a_2 \le b_2 \le \dots \le a_n \le b_n$ or $b_1 \le a_1 \le b_2 \le a_2 \le \dots \le b_n \le a_n$.

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, this is the finite set of integer points $\{e_1, \dots, e_d, (-1, \dots, -1)\} \subseteq \mathbb{Z}^d$, where $e_1, \dots, e_d$ are the standard basis vectors of $\mathbb{Z}^d$, so that $(-1, \dots, -1) = -(e_1 + \dots + e_d)$. These points are the vertices of the standard reflexive simplex $\Delta^d_{\mathrm{sr}}$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
